purpose: Compact source inventory for a future independent confirmation of the fixed 60-second exponentially decayed residual-history state.

selection_rule.primary: All 40 archives whose filenames match esl-pro-league-season-21-*.rar, ordered lexically by filename.
selection_rule.secondary: The first 10 archives whose filenames match iem-katowice-2025-*.rar, ordered lexically by filename.

metadata_index_definition: UTF-8 SHA-256 of newline-joined ordered source_archive|bytes|last_write_utc triples; not a content hash.

preliminary_exclusion_screen.method: Exact archive-basename comparison only; not match_id/map_id de-duplication.

required_before_freezing: Zero-overlap audit against D1-A/D1-B/D1-C/E1-v2 scope locks
Explicit authorization and a new frozen confirmation protocol before label access
evidence_boundary: This inventory does not establish independent eligibility, sufficient precision, model performance, hot-hand evidence, or authorization to access results.
